workspace.management.name: Workspace Management
workspace.management.description: Query, inspect, and switch active workspace.
workspace.management.fallback: Cannot manage workspaces via CLI. Use Mopheus Web UI.

ticket.basic.name: Ticket Basic CRUD
ticket.basic.description: Basic ticket querying, creation, and status updates.
ticket.basic.fallback: Cannot manage tickets via CLI. Use Mopheus Web UI.

ticket.file_input.name: Ticket File / Stdin Input
ticket.file_input.description: Pass large Markdown documents and multi-line comments via --description-file and --content-file without shell escaping issues.
ticket.file_input.fallback: Pass inline strings using --description '...' or --content '...', keeping text within 500 characters to prevent buffer errors.

ticket.metadata.name: Ticket Custom Metadata & Tags
ticket.metadata.description: Update structured ticket priority, tags, positions, and estimates.
ticket.metadata.fallback: Update tags and metadata directly in Mopheus Web UI.

ticket.lifecycle.name: Ticket Advanced Workflow & Lifecycle
ticket.lifecycle.description: Assign tickets, re-enqueue agent task execution, and export transcripts.
ticket.lifecycle.fallback: Re-run or assign tickets through the ticket detail page in Web UI.

ticket.grill.name: Ticket Review Grill
ticket.grill.description: Trigger self-Q&A review on a ticket.
ticket.grill.fallback: Conduct ticket reviews manually or via ticket comments.

project.management.name: Project Inspection
project.management.fallback: Query project details from Mopheus Web UI.

agent.management.name: Agent Inspection & Configuration
agent.management.description: Inspect agents, view system prompts, configure workspace agents, and view agent task history.
agent.management.fallback: Manage agents from the Agent configuration tab in Web UI.

agent.skills.name: Agent Skill Assignment & Roster
agent.skills.description: Inspect and manage skills assigned to specific workspace agents.
agent.skills.fallback: Configure agent skills in the Agent Settings tab in Mopheus Web UI.

team.management.name: Team Roster & Leader Instructions
team.management.description: Manage multi-agent team hierarchies and leader instructions.
team.management.fallback: Manage teams and roles from the Team settings in Web UI.

skill.import_export.name: Skill Import / Export & Sync
skill.import_export.description: Import local SKILL.md folders into workspace or export workspace skills.
skill.import_export.fallback: Upload or copy skill markdown files manually via Web UI.

job.basic.name: Job & Schedule Trigger Management
job.basic.description: Manage scheduled jobs, view run history, and trigger manual job runs.
job.basic.fallback: View job runs and manual triggers from Job management in Web UI.

job.event_filters.name: Event-Driven Job Triggers & Condition Filters
job.event_filters.description: Configure real-time event-driven triggers responding to ticket, comment, or runtime domain events with condition matching.
job.event_filters.fallback: Event trigger CLI flags are unavailable in your version. Please configure event triggers and conditions via Mopheus Web UI.

memory.search.name: Memory Distillation & Vector Search
memory.search.description: Semantic search and retrieval across workspace knowledge and error resolution memories.
memory.search.fallback: Search workspace knowledge base via Web UI search bar.

task.transcript_stream.name: Agent Task Transcript & Tool Step Parsing
task.transcript_stream.description: Inspect and stream detailed agent thinking steps, dialogue messages, and tool call executions.
task.transcript_stream.fallback: Use mop agent-task get <id> to inspect task status and summary without full step transcript.

search.global.name: Global Workspace Search
search.global.description: Full-text search across tickets, agents, skills, and projects in the active workspace.
search.global.fallback: Search individual resources with mop ticket list / mop agent list or use the Web UI search bar.

repo.management.name: Repository Links & Issue/PR Sync
repo.management.description: Manage GitHub/GitLab repository links and issue/PR synchronization on tickets.
repo.management.fallback: Manage repository links through the ticket detail page in Web UI.

chat.history.name: Chat & Channel History Inspection
chat.history.description: Read chat session messages and bound channel conversation history.
chat.history.fallback: View chat history directly in the Mopheus Web UI chat interface.

shortcut.execution.name: Skill Shortcut Execution on Tickets
shortcut.execution.description: List and trigger skill shortcuts directly on tickets with agent execution.
shortcut.execution.fallback: Assign the ticket to the agent with instructions or trigger the skill manually.

daemon.local_management.name: Daemon Service Control & Local Runtime
daemon.local_management.description: Start, stop, install, and check local Mopheus daemon background service.
daemon.local_management.fallback: You are running in non-daemon pure CLI client mode. Daemon management requires a local Mopheus Node. Use remote API commands instead.
